description: List the secrets stored in vernam: name, environment, target API and the last 4 characters only. Use the names as environment variables in commands you run with vernam_run. Secrets marked as plain (target "(plain env var: agents can read it)") are readable by design: commands run through vernam get their real values. API keys are brokered: commands only ever get placeholder tokens.

env.description: Only this environment (e.g. dev, staging, prod). Default: all.

name: vernam_list_secrets
title: List secret names
